content.text: Kicks are stronger. Kick the near west one.
Fighting fodder and trying to build a debris pile; continuing.
Two close, both winding up. Kick each.
Still fighting; I'm at 36 hp and will attack proactively.
Enemy winding up at north-northeast; kick it.
Two winding up. Punch the 16hp one, kick the other.
Down to 4 hp. Try to flee east away from the group.

I died in box 1 after about 31 seconds, so I escaped no boxes. I got 8 kills and a score of 1150.

The debris from kills was sparse and didn't build into a pile I could climb. Enemies kept hitting me and knocking me back, and I lost all my health before I could get anywhere near the rim.
